title: Outstandingly Oven Roasted Venezuelan Egg Noodles
description: A fresh and flaky Venezuelan dish featuring egg noodles, robata-grill flavors, and fodmap-friendly ingredients, perfect for a unique dinner experience. This recipe combines the richness of egg noodles with the bold flavors of Venezuelan cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the egg noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic-infused oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the diced onion and bell pepper to the bowl and toss to coat with the oil mixture.
Spread the onion and bell pepper mixture on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
Add the cooked egg noodles to the baking sheet and toss to combine with the roasted vegetables.
Add the diced grilled chicken breast to the baking sheet and toss to combine with the noodles and vegetables.
Return the baking sheet to the oven and roast for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
